name: Shades and Trades
slug: Where Sylan found the staff later fused to Ord's lantern.
description: Shades and Trades is where Sylan found the staff later fused to Ord's lantern, and where the DM believes that lantern was identified.

log.summary: Sylan recalls finding the staff here that was later fused to Ord's lantern, and the DM believes the lantern was identified at Shades and Trades. Sylan wonders aloud whether the place's records have been updated.
notes: Where Sylan found the staff later fused to Ord's lantern. The DM believes the lantern was identified here. Sylan wonders aloud whether the place's records have been updated.

log.summary: The shop is in the middle of New Navel. Sylan plans to bring the fused lantern-staff here to identify it, though he is unsure whether the party already did that, and he does not go there first. He first treats the proprietor as a living human, then decides the proprietor was a ghost. He has been around that proprietor before and has not taken him. He holds off on entering because of where the shop sits, then plans to reach it by the long way through town so he does not miss anyone.
